text_block_list.text: While out for a stroll around town on my day off, I spotted Satono Diamond looking rather troubled...
choice_data_list: Is something wrong?
Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer!
What perfect timing to run into you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Would you like to go to the amusement park with me?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Waaah~! So this is how lively amusement parks are on days when they aren't rented out!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm sorry for inviting you so suddenly. But these complimentary passes were expiring today, so you really saved me♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan had urgent business and had to head home...
I was just thinking about going all by myself instead!
choice_data_list: You must have really wanted to go.
You really wanted to come here, huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, absolutely! I was so excited I could barely sleep last night—my goodness!
Look over there, it's Uma-kun! Let's get a photo with him!
choice_data_list: Ah, wait up...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hurry, hurry! Trainer, you get in the frame too!
Say cheese...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Next up... Oh, look over there! What an enormous line...!
I want to wait in it! Let's go!
choice_data_list: You... want to wait in line...?
You... want to wait in line...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm usually ushered straight to the front, so...
I want to experience the thrill of waiting with anticipation!

I stood in line with her, chatting away for nearly an hour.
When our turn finally came, the attraction was...

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: GRAAAUUUGHHH~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!
choice_data_list: Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Ufufu! That gave me such a fright!
My, my♪ Where did you just pop out from!?
choice_data_list: (S-She seems fine...)
(S-She seems fine...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is this a secret door...!? Right here!?
Is the waiting area for the zombies back there...? Let's go see!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: A state-of-the-art haunted house...! I simply must see how it works behind the scenes!
choice_data_list: H-Hold on, wait, wait...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, that was so much fun...!
Every single attraction was wonderful!
choice_data_list: We sure ran around every inch of the park...!
We sure ran around every inch of the park...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the fun has only just begun~!
Next is the arcade corner! Come along, let's head over!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
They feature quite a few claw machines here
that were manufactured by our corporate group.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at that!
They have exclusive amusement park merchandise. How adorable...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Though looking at this positioning... it might be better to wait until after a restock.
Let's warm up on some of the other games until then!
choice_data_list: You really know your stuff, as expected.
You really know your stuff, as expected.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, claw machines are my specialty!
I've played them ever since I was a little girl—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whenever my parents visited our affiliate game company,
I'd often tag along with them...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
While waiting for their meetings to finish,
I would play on the arcade cabinets in the building.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, that was practically the main reason
I wanted to go with them...! Fufu♪
choice_data_list: Well then, let's see what you've got.
Well then, let's see what you've got.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Watch closely, now♪
Whatever you have your eye on, Trainer, I shall win it for you!

In the blink of an eye,
Satono Diamond swept up prize after prize...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu...♪ See? Not bad, right?
I can still win plenty more~!
choice_data_list: W-Wait, let's pack these up first...!

text_block_list.text:
We rearranged the prizes into shopping bags.
At this rate, both of us would be walking home with our arms completely full...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that might have been a bit too big of a haul.
Shall we call a taxi for the way back?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, I went and acted on a whim again...
...Ah—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it, the same thing happened during that 'Flower Project' campaign.
Trainer is always just tagging along with whatever I want to do...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Is this what my senior was talking about?
Am I taking advantage of Trainer's kindness...?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
choice_data_list: Dia?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um, please don't worry about the trip home, I'll take care of it!
I am an Umamusume after all, so I have plenty of strength.
choice_data_list: Ah, thank you.
Thanks, Dia.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No... I am sorry for getting so carried away.

Though she smiled as she spoke, something clearly seemed to be weighing on her mind.
Maybe lightening the mood would make it easier for her to open up...?
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll try my hand at the claw machine too.
Maybe I'll give the claw machine a shot too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! Good luck, Trainer!
My target... the one she said was cute earlier...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's... the park's exclusive plushie...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, you got it! Congratulations!
choice_data_list: Here, this one's for you.
Here, this one's for you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...! Ah...! Are you sure?
choice_data_list: As thanks for winning so many for me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You needn't thank me, I only won them because I wanted you to have them.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I know! I'll win another one so we can match—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
choice_data_list: Dia?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Um... no!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's nothing at all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I will cherish it deeply.

Satono Diamond offered a somewhat troubled smile.
I felt as though I had seen many new sides of her today—
